title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 4: Diamond is Unbreakable
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In the quiet town of Morioh in 1999, high schooler Josuke Higashikata, the illegitimate son of Joseph Joestar, uses his healing Stand to protect his neighbors. With Koichi, Okuyasu and an adult Jotaro he deals with Stand users created by a mysterious bow and arrow, and gradually uncovers Yoshikage Kira, a seemingly ordinary office worker who is a serial killer with a hand fetish hiding in plain sight.
life_message: It holds up protecting your hometown and its ordinary people, with kindness and courage.

content.note: Kira murders women and keeps their hands; Angelo kills Josuke's grandfather; explosive Stand fights; Shigechi killed (Wikipedia; CSM on the anime).
Serial-killer suspense, a ghost girl murdered years before, body horror such as Angelo fused into a rock (Wikipedia; AniList Gore, Body Horror signals).
Kira's fetish for women's hands treated as perverse; Koichi and Yukako's romance (Wikipedia; CSM).
Delinquent banter; CSM notes language increases over the franchise (to verify in this part).
Kira's compulsions; Hayato's fear living with a killer posing as his father (Wikipedia).
Delinquent styling and fights; Rohan's reckless curiosity.
Large franchise and a live-action film (CSM; Wikipedia).
